name: Aptum
title_zh: 六个技能凑成一套，先看它们怎么互相接活
tagline_zh: 单装一个技能总在边界卡住：写完的稿子没人接、查完的资料没人整理。这包六个是按流水线配的。
tagline_en: Single skills stall at the handoff. These six are wired as a pipeline: each one's output is the next one's input.
why_zh: 它卖的不是六个独立工具，是六段咬合的工序。接口对齐过，所以中间不用你复制粘贴转格式。
why_en: Not six standalone tools but six interlocking stages, with interfaces aligned so you never copy-paste between them.
limit_zh: 必须六个一起装，单拆一个会在交接处断掉；只覆盖它预设的那条流水线，你想插自己的步骤得改配置；产物到交接文件为止。
limit_en: Install all six together; a single one breaks at the handoff. It only covers its preset pipeline, and stops at the handoff file — no final layout or.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Six skills that hand work off to each other
